title: Docs lie detector
description: Every claim of the README checked against the code and a real run; only the provider.

de.title: Lügendetektor für Dokumentation
de.description: Jede Aussage der README gegen den Code und einen echten Lauf geprüft; nur der Anbieter.

prompt: Read README* and docs/. For every concrete claim (an option, a default, a command's output, a file path), check it against the code and, where you can, by running it. Do not change the code. Write /work/DOCS-AUDIT.md: claim, where, true/false/unclear, evidence.
